incidents.name: DOGGO self-balance-triggered swapback sandwich
incidents.notes: DOGGO's transfer hook fired an internal, slippage-free Uniswap sale of the token's own accumulated fee balance whenever balanceOf(DOGGO) crossed a hard-coded 4.2069e18 threshold, and because anyone can donate tokens to the contract the attacker controlled exactly when that sale fired and sandwiched it inside a flash loan.

sources.ref: onchain review: DOGGO 0x240Cd7b53d364a208eD41f8cEd4965D11F571B7a created 2024-09-20T19:27:59Z by 0x6d3983850d689cae3e9c8f5150de25d9ece80732, not the attack-tx sender 0x7248939f65bdd23aab9eaab1bc4a4f909567486e; no EIP-1967 events, 3.07 hours old. Reported loss 7k USD.
